definition.en: The end of a muscle that usually stays still when it contracts.
definition.zh: 肌肉收缩时通常不动的那一端。

definition.en: The end of a muscle that it pulls toward the origin when it contracts.
definition.zh: 肌肉收缩时被拉向起点的那一端。

definition.en: The shallow socket on the shoulder blade that holds the head of the humerus.
definition.zh: 肩胛骨上承接肱骨头的浅窝。

definition.en: Four muscles, supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis, whose tendons wrap the shoulder joint and hold the head of the humerus in its socket.
definition.zh: 冈上肌、冈下肌、小圆肌和肩胛下肌四块肌肉。它们的腱包住肩关节，把肱骨头稳在关节盂里。

definition.en: The flat end of the scapular spine that forms the bony roof of the shoulder.
definition.zh: 肩胛冈外端扁平的骨突，构成肩部的骨性屋顶。

definition.en: A rough patch halfway down the outer side of the humerus where all three parts of the deltoid attach.
definition.zh: 肱骨外侧中段的一块粗糙骨面，三角肌三个部分都止在这里。

definition.en: A muscle build in which short fibres join several tendon sheets inside the muscle at an angle, like several feathers side by side.
definition.zh: 肌肉内部有几片腱膜，短纤维斜着接在上面，像几根羽毛并排在一起。

definition.en: The larger bump at the top of the humerus; supraspinatus, infraspinatus and teres minor attach to its three facets.
definition.zh: 肱骨上端较大的骨性突起；冈上肌、冈下肌和小圆肌分别止于它的三个小面。

definition.en: The smaller bump on the front of the top of the humerus, where subscapularis attaches.
definition.zh: 肱骨上端前面较小的骨性突起，肩胛下肌止于这里。

definition.en: Moving a limb away from the midline of the body, such as lifting the arm out to the side.
definition.zh: 让肢体离开身体中线的动作，例如把手臂向侧面抬起。

definition.en: Opening a raised arm out and back, in a level plane.
definition.zh: 把抬到前面的手臂在水平面上向外、向后打开。

definition.en: Turning the upper arm outward about its own long axis; with the elbow bent at your side, the forearm swings away from the belly.
definition.zh: 上臂绕着自己的长轴向外转；手肘弯着贴在身体旁边时，前臂会从肚子前面向外摆开。

definition.en: Electromyography: recording the electrical activity of a muscle. Higher EMG does not by itself mean more strength or growth.
definition.zh: 肌电图：记录肌肉的电活动。肌电高本身不等于更有力或长得更多。

definition.en: The part of a movement in which a working muscle lengthens under load, such as lowering a weight under control.
definition.zh: 动作中正在用力的肌肉在负荷下被拉长的阶段，例如有控制地放下重量。
